args.brief: Chapter 3, "The Duplicate". Nadi reads the handling note and asks Sol for the missing second page of the flight register; Sol produces a duplicate. Foreground Nadi openly crediting Wren for the document work: when Sol asks who found the gap, Nadi names Wren plainly and without hedging, and repeats the credit in front of the demonstration organiser. Practical actions precise: gloved handling, pencil notes, the wooden sleeve stays sealed and intact on its padded cradle throughout. Quiet tone, third-person past tense on Nadi, about 750 words.
